The three pairings give the values $y_1=z_1z_2+z_3z_4$, $y_2=z_1z_3+z_2z_4$, $y_3=z_1z_4+z_2z_3$. These are the roots of the resolvent cubic
$$y^3-e_2y^2+(e_1e_3-4e_4)y-(e_1^2e_4-4e_2e_4+e_3^2)=0.$$

From $f$, the symmetric functions are $e_1=-14$, $e_2=52$, $e_3=-56$, $e_4=16$.

- $e_1e_3-4e_4=784-64=720$.
- $e_1^2e_4-4e_2e_4+e_3^2=3136-3328+3136=2944$.

So the cubic is $y^3-52y^2+720y-2944=0$.

Testing $y=8$: $512-3328+5760-2944=0$, so $y=8$ is a root. Factoring gives
$$(y-8)(y^2-44y+368)=0.$$

The quadratic has roots $22\pm 2\sqrt{29}\approx 11.23$ and $32.77$. All three values are real and positive, so the smallest absolute value is $8$.
